title: 🎥 Long queues for gasoline in the UAE
text:
🎥 Long queues for gasoline in the UAE"

"🔹 Following a 16% increase in gasoline prices in the UAE, cars were seen queuing at gas stations before the price hike took effect."

"🔹 The increase in fuel prices has occurred due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, the rise in global oil prices, and disruptions in energy supply and transportation.
